subject.title: fix(usage): show provider quota in usage footer

question: Should `/usage` reply footers perform a timeout-bounded provider-usage lookup during final reply delivery, or should quota text wait for cached/preloaded provider usage state?
rationale: The code path is focused and proof-backed, but it intentionally adds auth/provider probing to final reply delivery where latency and omit-on-timeout behavior are product tradeoffs rather than pure correctness.

options.title: Accept Bounded Lookup
options.body: Restore the docs and land this design if maintainers accept a 2500 ms omit-on-failure quota probe for usage-enabled replies.

options.title: Require Cached State
options.body: Ask the PR to use warmed or cached provider quota snapshots before adding quota text to reply footers.

options.title: Keep Status Only
options.body: Close or pause this direction if provider quota windows should remain available only through `/status` and CLI status surfaces.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Lookup
recommendation.body: Restore the docs and land this design if maintainers accept a 2500 ms omit-on-failure quota probe for usage-enabled replies.

likelyOwner.reason: History connects this person to the provider-usage/status seam and recent current-main work on the same helper surfaces.
